baslik: Forest fire and non-fire sample points with eleven conditioning factors for Muğla, Türkiye (2015–2024)
aciklama: 6746 sampled points (3373 fire, 3373 non-fire) used for forest fire susceptibility modelling in Muğla province, Türkiye. Columns: Actual (1 = fire, 0 = non-fire), Aspect (9 classes), NDVI, Slope (degrees), Temperature (°C, annual mean 2015–2024), Wind Speed (m/s), Elevation (m), Rainfall (mm, monthly mean), Land Cover (CORINE 2018 classes), Distance to Roads / Streams / Settlements (m). Fire records: Muğla Regional Directorate of Forestry.
